Computes code violations per 1,000 adults and CDC high blood pressure prevalence per Montgomery census tract for 2026, then returns the correlation coefficient and paired tract count across all eligible tracts with non-null health values, ordered by violation rate descending.
sql:
WITH paired AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name,
    COALESCE(cv.n, 0) AS code_violations_count,
    cd.totalpopulation,
    cd.totalpop18plus,
    cd.bphigh_crudeprev AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fw_pg.tract_counts cv
    ON t.geoid = cv.geoid
   AND cv.run_id = 'r_20261025_99f7c4'
   AND cv.source = 'm1_city'
  LEFT JOIN session.fw_99f7c4_m2_cdc cd
    ON t.geoid = cd.tractfips
  WHERE cd.bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  geoid,
  name,
  code_violations_count,
  totalpopulation,
  totalpop18plus,
  CAST(code_violations_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) * 1000 AS code_violations_per_1000_adults,
  high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  CORR(
    CAST(code_violations_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) * 1000,
    high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  ) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_adults DESC,
  name ASC
LIMIT 200

Joins the 71 Montgomery tracts with non-missing CDC high-blood-pressure prevalence to their 2026 code-violation totals, computes violations per 1,000 residents using totalpopulation, and returns the overall correlation and paired-tract count ranked by the violation rate.
sql:
WITH health AS (
  SELECT
    cd.tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(cd.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
    CAST(cd.totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(cd.bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_99f7c4_m2_cdc_v2 cd
  WHERE cd.bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
violations AS (
  SELECT
    c.geoid,
    SUM(c.n) AS code_violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts c
  WHERE c.run_id = 'r_20261025_99f7c4'
    AND c.source = 'm1_city_v2'
    AND c.grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY c.geoid
)
SELECT
  h.geoid,
  t.name,
  CAST(COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) / h.totalpopulation * 1000 AS code_violations_per_1000_residents,
  COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) AS code_violations_count,
  h.totalpopulation,
  h.totalpop18plus,
  h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence,
  CORR(
    CAST(COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) / h.totalpopulation * 1000,
    h.high_blood_pressure_prevalence
  ) OVER () AS correlation,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts
FROM health h
JOIN fw_pg.tracts t ON t.geoid = h.geoid
LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = h.geoid
ORDER BY code_violations_per_1000_residents DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
